description.en: The name of the LiveChannel. The LiveChannel must exist.

description.zh:
指定查询ts文件的终止时间。
格式：Unix timestamp
>EndTime必须大于StartTime，且时间跨度不能大于1天。
description.en:
The end time for querying TS files.
Format: UNIX timestamp.
>EndTime must be greater than StartTime, and the time span cannot exceed one day.

description.zh: 指定生成的点播播放列表的名称，必须以“.m3u8”结尾。
description.en: The name of the VOD playlist to generate. The name must end with ".m3u8".

description.zh: 指定查询ts文件的起始时间，格式为Unix timestamp。
description.en: The start time for querying TS files. Format: UNIX timestamp.

title.zh: 为直播推流生成点播的播放列表
title.en: Generate a VOD playlist for a live stream

descriptions.zh: OSS会查询指定时间范围内由该LiveChannel推流生成的ts文件，并将其拼装为一个m3u8播放列表。
descriptions.en: OSS queries the TS files generated by the specified LiveChannel within the specified time range and assembles them into an M3U8 playlist.
